options.label: Breathing room · Pattern
options.note: Name affected enemies, let the party choose a target order, then protect concentration.

options.label: Hold a route · Web
options.note: Keep allies outside, name actually Restrained enemies, and preserve a clear route.

options.label: One enemy · Command
options.note: Choose the result, then coordinate around the enemy’s next turn; no concentration.

options.label: Keep the opening alive
options.note: Say what your concentration is buying, then choose a cantrip, Dodge, or an objective action.

options.label: Let the scout lead
options.note: Agree on a route and return plan, then hold Invisibility while the scout makes the decisions.

options.label: An ally’s flight plan
options.note: Ask who wants Fly and agree on a landing before changing concentration.

options.label: Ask an animal
options.note: Ask what the animal actually noticed and invite the party’s next question.

options.label: The Syrup Witness
options.note: Illustrate the account, invite corrections, then hand the next question to a teammate.

options.label: Management in the smoke
options.note: Offer one small elemental flourish and let the DM resolve any proposed consequence.

options.label: Mending: a quiet favor
options.note: Repair a small break within the spell’s limits, then let the conversation grow from the favor.
